question: Should this internal gateway refactor require fresh live Gateway evidence for the preserved first-connection and stale-Watch ordering invariant before merge?
rationale: Focused tests and changed-file checks support the implementation, but the external-PR proof gate requires observed after-fix behavior for this runtime-sensitive refactor.

options.title: Require targeted live proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Gateway run that demonstrates the preserved alert and timestamp-ordering behavior after this refactor.

options.title: Accept prior live proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the prior merged fix's live scenario as sufficient evidence for this behavior-neutral refactor.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Defer the cleanup if fresh proof cannot be supplied and the invariant remains too risky to validate from tests alone.

recommendation.title: Require targeted live proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Gateway run that demonstrates the preserved alert and timestamp-ordering behavior after this refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related merged implementation and this focused follow-up, so they have the strongest direct context for the intended invariant and proof path.
